subject: Halcyon MAP: stabilization check-in and proposed timeline carve
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@halcyon.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Halcyon MAP: stabilization check-in and proposed timeline carve

Sarah / team —

Quick notes after the stand this morning. The MAP (attached: halcyon_map_v3.xlsx) still shows the final eval gate slipping ~10 business days vs the committed close date. For context: Halcyon needs the evaluation tranche (Tranche A) to run for 7 days of live tests; the procurement window for the dedicated capacity blocks is forecasting an extra 6–8 business days. That combination pushes the current close beyond their fiscal milestone.

I want to capture a short risk log and a proposed mitigation we can move on quickly:
- Risk: eval window + procurement delay => close slips ~2 weeks. Impact: Q3 go-live risk and internal exec churn for Halcyon.
- Near-term mitigation (what we can do this week):
  1) Offer a split-delivery MAP: allow Tranche A to start on hosted with a documented fallback to Dedicated once procurement clears — reduces probe time to prove value.
  2) Accelerate our provisioning lane: prioritize the Halcyon queue for one dedicated node (compute surge) to shorten procurement-related validation.
  3) Shorten Tranche A to 5 days but require a focused test script (attached: eval-plan-trancheA.pdf) and agree acceptance metrics.

Please review the attached MAP and eval plan; I want a single-page recommendation and a go / no-go by EOD Tue so I can propose this back to Sarah and Ben (procurement). Laura: can you run the procurement ask with Ben and confirm any gating items we can't waive? Dylan: can you estimate the delta in our cost if we provision the surge node for two weeks? Neha: if we offer a temporary credit to offset the compute surge, what is the approval path?

If we can align internally fast, I’ll coordinate with Sarah to update the MAP and provide a compressed schedule for their execs.

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: halcyon_map_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-plan-trancheA.pdf (PDF)
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@halcyon.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@procureworks.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon MAP: stabilization check-in and proposed timeline carve

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear summary and options. High level: the execs are anxious about hitting the end-of-month close and would prefer not to push revenue into the next quarter. Our legal team is fine with a split-delivery approach but procurement has a hard lead time because our internal security validation requires our vendor to pass one last infra attestation (that's the 6–8 business day blocker).

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood confirm the exact acceptance criteria for a 5-day Tranche A (we need pass/fail lights)? The eval-plan you attached is a good start but we need the acceptance matrix in-line.
2) If Redwood can provide temporary hosted capacity for Tranche A with an explicit rollback to Dedicated, can ProcureWorks do accelerated vendor vetting? Ben — any wiggle room on the vendor checklist if we provide the attestation artifacts early?

I’ve attached our internal procurement summary (procurement_summary_Q3.pdf) so you can see the gating steps. I’ll convene Ben and legal tomorrow at 9am PT if we have a recommended path.

—Sarah
VP Product, Halcyon Analytics
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@halcyon.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon MAP: stabilization check-in and proposed timeline carve

Stephanie / team —

I took a quick look at the procurement summary. Ben, two notes:
- The vendor attestation Halcyon references is the standard security questionnaire plus an infra scan. If Halcyon delivers the attestation artifacts (IP allowlist + scan report) to ProcureWorks, we can likely shave 3–4 business days off the gating step.
- If Redwood is willing to accept a hosted-first Tranche A with a signed rollback clause in the MAP, legal is comfortable with that path as long as we commit to a definitive Dedicated handover window.

Dylan: preliminary cost delta for a two-week surge node is ~USD 9,500 (GPU-backed, pre-tax). That assumes we reassign an existing pre-warm node; provisioning a brand-new full cluster would be higher. Neha: if we want to make a credit offer to offset 50% of that delta for the two-week window, what internal approval level do we need?

Sarah: if you can push the attestation artifacts to Ben today, I’ll flag this as high priority on our side and draft the rollback wording to add to the MAP.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success Ops
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@halcyon.ai>; Ben Turner <ben.turner@procureworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon MAP: stabilization check-in and proposed timeline carve

Quick update and escalation note —

Thanks everyone for moving fast. Summary of decisions/asks:
- Halcyon to provide attestation artifacts to Ben by EOD Thu.
- Redwood to provision hosted Tranche A to start on Mon 19 Jul (5 business days). Dylan will spin-up the pre-warm node; cost delta ~USD 9,500.
- Laura to add explicit rollback and Dedicated handover language to MAP v3; I’ll circulate for countersign.
- Neha: please confirm if a 50% temporary credit needs CRO sign-off or if you can approve at your level; if not, I need escalation to finance by Fri EOD.

If we get attestation + confirmation on credit approval, we can hold to the current close target with no more than a 2–3 business day slip; without that, Halcyon will push the close into the next fiscal period.

Plan: I’ll run a 30-minute exec sync with Sarah, Ben, Laura and Neha Friday at 08:00 PT if we need approvals. Otherwise I’ll update the MAP doc and send for signature.

-Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: halcyon_map_v3.xlsx, eval-plan-trancheA.pdf, procurement_summary_Q3.pdf
